craft_notes: Sthāyin: maṅgala-bhakti of salute-and-likeness — imitation as veneration; FIRST VERSE of the work sets the house voice (door-command, terminal doctrine words; owner verdict required). Three-undiffering; holds (not lasts — holding is active). Rejected: (a) apart→separate → killed: apart is spaced. Read aloud: PRAISED, PRAIS-er, PRAISE … SO-this be-COMES.

lines: Praised, praiser, praise — though three, nothing here apart;
it holds: whatever shape, by knowing-shape, so this becomes.
l4.sanskrit_cite: stutyaḥ stotā stutir iti yad api vibhinnaṃ | mṛṣati yathā yad rūpaṃ cidrūpatayā

reads_against.argmap: Do praised, praiser, praise differ? → Praised-praiser-praise undiffering; consciousness-formed becoming endures.
c1_essence: Alone supreme nectar-one ablaze, all-swallowed: venerated.
Melted bliss-mass; principle likened in form venerated.
Script-outlines man; shape reveals varied You.
Light-goddess-flowers arranged; guru unfolded, heart entered.
Reflecting praise in body-temple, bonds outpoured.
Five-named conquer; splits gained, mouths called.
